debug.description: Enable full request/response tracing (method, URL, headers, body) to diagnose API issues such as WAF/proxy blocks. Can also be enabled via the ILERT_DEBUG environment variable. WARNING: the resulting debug logs contain request and response bodies and other potentially sensitive data (the Authorization header is masked) - do not share them or commit them to CI logs.

auto_create_services.description: Automatically create services for unmatched service identifiers extracted by the services template.

escalation_policy.description: The escalation policy specifies who will be notified when an alert is created by this alert source

name.description: The name of the resource, also acts as it's unique ID

interval_sec.description: The interval after which the heartbeat alert source will create an alert if it does not receive a ping

summary.description: This text will be used as the alert summary, when alerts are created by this alert source

block.description: A heartbeat alert source will automatically create an alert if it does not receive a heartbeat signal from your app at regular intervals.
Default services that get attached to every alert created by this alert source.

Dynamic services mapping. Each template extracts service identifiers from the inbound event payload. Each rendered value is comma-split and each token is resolved against the tenant's services by alias or name (case-insensitive). Unmatched tokens are silently dropped.
Please make sure to follow the instructions for setting a structure with Terraform in the status page group example.
